narrative.overview: A chart drawn on plaster. One ink line runs down the page like a thread on a map, and products sit on it as ports. The founder is the captain and the agents are the ship. The historical captain of the route is never named.
keyCharacteristics: Plaster ground, ink line, one blue accent
One line weight family with round caps and ring joints
No boxes, cards or rules; space and the line separate things
Plates carry no shadow; only drawn devices do
Light and dark are both first class; reduced motion is respected

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only color that acts. Structure is line. Nothing else gets a hue.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The serif says things. The sans explains them.

rules.name: The Plates Are Flat Rule
rules.body: A picture of a screen gets no shadow, border or frame. Only drawn devices have a bezel and shadow.

dos: Use tokens by name, defined once per theme
Draw diagrams in the one line
Add products as ports on the thread
Keep pressables pill-shaped and at least 44px tall
Respect reduced motion in every new animation
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradient or glow
Don't name the voyage's historical captain
Don't show Blackfin results or any personal name beyond the founder line
